why: The twelve arm cells of the v0.7.0 gate were measured before the runners recorded their own role, and measured data is never mutated, so the role is declared here instead of edited into the result files. Each entry names the SLURM job that wrote the cell and the submitter batch it belonged to; `sacct -X -j <id> -o JobID,JobName` is the record. Cells produced after this commit carry their own `role` and ignore this file.
